Figure 3. Framework Overview: We obtain training data through two complementary approaches: (i) Event Data Factory: SVRaster [59] generates synthetic event stereo pairs and depth labels from sparse RGB images via virtual camera trajectories (left); (ii) Stereo CrossModal Distillation: existing RGB stereo models produce proxy depth labels for real event data in calibrated RGB-Event stereo setups (top right). (iii) Both data sources are combined in EventHub to train/adapt event stereo networks (bottom right).
